raw:
Ralf Schumacher had one second- or third-place finish in 2006: 3rd at the Australian Grand Prix (Toyota, round 3).

I checked the race reports for 16 of the 18 rounds. Each report lists the top 10 only, so a 2nd or 3rd place would have shown up in any race I checked:

- **Podium (2nd/3rd):** Australia (3rd).
- **Top 10, not on the podium:** Malaysia (8th), San Marino (9th), Monaco (8th), France (4th), Germany (9th), Hungary (6th), Turkey (7th), Japan (7th).
- **Not in the top 10:** Bahrain, Spain, Canada, Europe, Britain, Italy, China and Brazil. He does not appear in any of these reports, so he finished 11th or lower, retired, or was not listed.
- **Not checked:** Belgium. My search returned only other years' Belgian races, so I could not confirm his result there.
- **Indianapolis:** he retired (+11 laps).

ANSWER: 1
